hypothesis: Indie iOS developers who will not buy a market-intelligence subscription will pay $19 once for a single-genre brief that shows who entered, left, or moved on the US Top Free, Top Grossing, and Top Paid charts since the stored snapshot from at least seven days earlier.
audience: Indie iOS developers and small studios checking whether a US category is crowded before they build.
offer: One-time US genre chart brief at $19. The largest genre stays free on the public page. The existing all-app chart table stays free.
success_metric: One paid order from a customer who is not the owner, reconciled from the payment processor.
secondary_observation: GitHub genre-interest issues. They are not success and they are not revenue.
window_starts: The UTC day card checkout first opens. While checkout is closed the experiment is blocked, not failed.
stop_or_pivot: If checkout has been open for 14 days and paid orders are still zero, stop this price and packaging. Change the offer, the audience, or the price. Do not add features in order to avoid a zero. Do not paywall the existing free chart table.
why_this_offer: Appfigures lists competitor intelligence well above $19, with public plan prices from $9.99/month for a limited Connect plan up to $149.99/month and higher for broader intelligence. The Chartspur chart table already gives away current single-chart rows. Rank movement across the three US top charts is computed from stored snapshots and is not on that table. Fulfillment is a local script with no new vendor spend.
notes: 2026-10-15: live card checkout opened in commit 57fd7eb (Stripe Payment Link in ops/payments.json). The 14-day window starts on this UTC day.
2026-10-15: the site moved from https://myrmitis.github.io/appsignal/ to https://chartspur.com/ after the repository rename. The success metric did not change.
2026-10-30: day-14 result recorded (window ended 2026-10-29). No paid order is recorded; the zero is not reconciled with Stripe because agents cannot read it (#12). Pivot decision: #13.

result.evidence: ops/ledger.json lists no orders and cash_collected_usd 0; ops/summary.json shows paying_customers 0. Agents cannot read Stripe orders: the read-only key in myrmitis/chartspur#12 does not exist yet.
result.verdict: Success not shown. The success metric needs one paid order reconciled from the processor, and no order is recorded. The stop_or_pivot rule applies unless the owner's Stripe dashboard shows a paid order from someone other than the owner.
result.next: Owner decision in myrmitis/chartspur#13: change the offer, the audience or the price. Do not add features to avoid a zero, and do not paywall the free chart table.
